Released: 2 June 2026

WEM 1.2.0 includes new features, enhancements, and bug fixes.

## Highlights

- **Resource management schedules:** Define schedules to automatically apply [resource group and resource queue settings](../performance/managing-resources#scheduling-resource-limits) at specific days and times. Each schedule can target multiple groups at once, supports dry-run preview, manual activation, and pause/resume controls, and logs every execution in a history view.
- **Query Editor as a standalone page:** The [**Query Editor**](../performance/query-monitor#using-the-query-editor) is now a top-level page with dedicated role-based access controls, making it easier to find and govern SQL authoring separately from workload monitoring.
- **Configuration History:** A new [**Configuration History**](../monitoring/cluster-overview#reviewing-configuration-changes) tab on the **Cluster** page provides a time-ordered audit trail of configuration parameter changes, helping teams quickly identify what changed and when.
- **Prometheus remote write receiver:** WEM can now accept inbound metrics from Grafana Alloy or any Prometheus-compatible client, unifying cluster and infrastructure metrics at the [`/prom/metrics`](../installing/wem#remote-write-receiver-optional) endpoint.
- **Service identity and PXF integration:** The WEM system service now runs as `gpadmin` instead of root, which is required for PXF integration. Two new CLI commands, `wem configure-pxf-sandbox` and `wem configure-user`, handle post-install PXF configuration and OS user changes. No manual steps are required when upgrading from 1.0 or 1.1. See [Upgrading WEM](../installing/upgrading).

## Features

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Force password change</summary><hr/><p>Administrators can now require a user to change their password at next login directly from the WEM interface. See <a href="../system-access/management#managing-the-user-lifecycle">Managing the user lifecycle</a>.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Role-level Postgres settings</summary><hr/><p>You can now configure Postgres parameters at the role level from the role edit form in <a href="../system-access/access-management#configuring-role-level-postgres-settings">Access Management</a>. Role-level settings override cluster-wide defaults for sessions started by that role.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Date-range picker in System Metrics</summary><hr/><p>The <a href="../monitoring/system-metrics#selecting-a-time-range">System Metrics</a> page now includes a date-range picker, giving you precise control over the time window displayed across all charts and tables.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Admin-only action enforcement</summary><hr/><p>Action buttons restricted to Admin users are now disabled rather than hidden for non-admin users, making permission boundaries visible across the interface.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Reason input on cancel and terminate dialogs</summary><hr/><p>When canceling a query or terminating a session, you can now provide an optional reason. The reason is recorded in the WEM audit log. See <a href="../performance/query-monitor">Monitoring and evaluating queries</a>.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>State column in Sessions</summary><hr/><p>The <strong>Sessions</strong> tab in <a href="../performance/query-monitor#resolving-connection-leaks-and-session-bloat">Query Monitoring</a> now includes a <strong>State</strong> column showing the current connection state. The <strong>Connections</strong> column is removed.</p>
</details></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Changes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Alerts subsystem: WEM's internal alert engine is removed</summary><hr/><p>Alert rules are now defined as Prometheus rule files. Recreate any rules previously configured through WEM as Prometheus YAML files. See the <a href="../reference">Reference</a> section for the pre-built rules shipped with WEM.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>The <code>gpadmin</code> OS user is now required for fresh installs</summary><hr/><p>The installer fails if <code>gpadmin</code> doesn't exist on the WEM host. On hosts where the older WEM ran as <code>root</code>, the upgrade automatically configures WEM to continue running as root. See <a href="../installing/prerequisites">Prerequisites</a> and <a href="../installing/upgrading">Upgrading WEM</a>.</p>
</details></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Bug Fixes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>Fixed the Dashboard CPU and Memory charts not aggregating data correctly across nodes.</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed PXF cluster status detection from systemd, and an upgrade-time failure creating <code>~gpadmin/gpAdminLogs</code></summary><hr/><p>Fixed an upgrade-time failure where <code>~gpadmin/gpAdminLogs</code> wasn't created, causing <code>systemctl restart wem</code> to log <code>install: cannot change owner and permissions of '/home/gpadmin/gpAdminLogs': No such file or directory</code>.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed the Storage page not applying the default filter for physical disks.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed WEM not showing an alert when Prometheus returns no metrics data.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed the coordinator and standby being incorrectly included in the Segment Details table.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed the username not displaying in the top right of the screen when the user's full name is empty.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed pagination controls not appearing when the page size equals the total number of items.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>
